new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing businesses, responsible for defining and delivering a collection of advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Brand advertising is at the center of that growth, and brand marketers are pushing the industry toward a fundamental shift: they no longer want to optimize toward proxy metrics like reach and frequency alone. They want their investment across Streaming TV, online video, and display to drive measurable business outcomes, from consideration through to purchase and long-term loyalty. The core scientific challenge is connecting a brand ad exposure today to an outcome that may happen days or weeks later, and then optimizing for it in real time.  
  
The Brand Outcomes Optimization team exists to solve that challenge. We build machine-learned models that predict how likely a customer is to move along the full funnel, from awareness through conversion, and we integrate those predictions into real-time bidding so that every brand bid is placed on the opportunity most likely to produce the outcome the advertiser cares about. These systems operate at large scale, and even small improvements to how we predict and optimize for outcomes have meaningful and immediate impact on advertiser results.  
  
As an Applied Scientist II, you will help drive this outcome-optimization. You will take on increasingly ambiguous problems, from predicting what a brand outcome will be, to building the bidding and control algorithms that optimize for it, to proving the lift through experimentation. You will work alongside senior scientists and engineers, applying advances in machine learning, online optimization, optimal control, forecasting, and causal inference. You will also join the Amazon science community, with opportunities to publish papers, attend workshops and conferences, and gain early access to Amazon ML technologies.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will work with a highly motivated team of ML scientists and engineers focused on making brand advertising measurable and optimizable against real outcomes. As an Applied Scientist II, you will:  
  

* Contribute to outcome-driven brand optimization, helping define, predict, and bid toward brand outcomes across channels.
* Build prediction models that estimate a customer's likelihood to progress through the funnel, and integrate them into bidding systems.
* Develop the optimization and control algorithms that turn outcome predictions into bids.
* Own projects end to end: frame the problem and success metrics, build and validate prototypes, partner with engineers to productionize, and prove impact through offline analysis and online A/B experimentation.
* Help establish scalable, automated processes for training, monitoring, and feedback so outcome optimization stays reliable and performant at scale.
* Contribute to the science bar on the team through design and model reviews.

* PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience

Bring your expertise to JPMorgan Chase. As part of Risk Management and Compliance, you are at the center of keeping JPMorgan Chase strong and resilient. You help the firm grow its business in a responsible way by anticipating new and emerging risks, and using your expert judgement to solve real-world challenges that impact our company, customers and communities. Our culture in Risk Management and Compliance is all about thinking outside the box, challenging the status quo and striving to be best-in-class.

As a Data Scientist within our innovative team, you will be tasked with devising and developing Proofs of Concept (POCs) and deployable models using AI/ML techniques, algorithms and other statistical and numerical methods. You will also be responsible for extracting and working with large volumes of data (both structured and unstructured) from multiple sources, transforming it into an analysis-ready format to develop the data pipeline. Additionally, you will be expected to independently formulate methodologies, and quantitative and analytical tasks, from business problems.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Analyze complex/unstructured data to understand the business problem and use case
* Analyze business requirements, design, and develop appropriate methodology; And develop deployable, scalable and effective models/ analytical methods as part of technology managed system or as a self-served application of a business user
* Work collaboratively and creatively with other data scientists, technology partners, risk professionals, model validation teams, etc.

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* 2+ years of related experience in Python, R or Scala with Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Physical Sciences, Econometrics, Statistics, or other any quantitative discipline.
* Demonstrable theoretical and application knowledge of Machine Learning methods, and/or Statistical Models
* Demonstrable hands-on experience and familiarity with LLM prompt engineering and agentic solution development.
* Demonstrable hands-on experience and familiarity with the following packages, algorithms, and/or alternatives, including ML Packages (Pandas, Scikit-Learn, XGBoost, catboost, lightgbm, automl, Optuna, Hyperopt), Visualization Packages (Matplotlib, Seaborn, Geopandas), Algorithm (Louvain / Hierarchical Clustering, Label Propagation, Connected Component Analysis, Graph Neural net (Graph Attention Network), Page Rank, Centrality Analysis, Tree based Analysis, Outlier Detection Methods, Zero Shot/ Few Shot learning)
* Hands-on professional experience in software development especially with analytical & computationally intensive systems, digital transformations leveraging cloud technologies (AWS, GCP, Azure, Databricks etc.)
* Experience in developing and operationalization of data pipelines
* Experience with process, controls and governance of a highly regulated environment
* Experience of data mining and visualization tools including Tableau, Alteryx, Qlik for generating user interface of business solutions; Assimilating large amounts of data from multiple databases and utilize them for creating actionable outcome; Adhering to a standardized analysis and project methodology; and Documenting quantitative analysis

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Post graduate degrees such as Master's Degree, PhD, etc. is preferred
* Working knowledge of C/C#/C++ or others is a plus
* Real life exposure to Agile SDLC, ModelOps and /Or Design Thinking is desirable.
* Familiarity with Natural Language Processing techniques is a plus
* Experience with Large Language Models and Suites is a plus
* Familiarity with graph-based learning and graph Database like, TigerGraph, Neo4j is a plus
* A self-starter and strong influencing skills with strong communication skills

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

AWS Insights & Optimization is looking for an Applied Scientist to help develop sophisticated algorithms and models that involve analyzing and learning from over 540 billion customer cost, usage, and utilization events daily. We use this data to power cost anomaly detection, cost forecasting, rightsizing recommendations across seven compute services, Savings Plans optimization, and AI-powered conversational experiences that help customers understand and optimize their AWS spend. Our team's vision is to be the world's provider of intelligent AWS cloud financial management, where customers can understand, control, and optimize usage of AWS products. We sit at the nexus of all AWS services and interact directly with end-customers, building relationships with teams across AWS to ensure we offer a secure and reliable experience that builds trust and provides intelligent insights.  
  
As a successful Applied Scientist in AWS Insights & Optimization, you will own models end-to-end — from problem formulation through experimentation to production deployment. Your work may span cost anomaly detection (decomposition, detection, and root cause attribution), time-series forecasting with a focus on accuracy and consistency, rightsizing engines for EC2, EBS, Lambda, ECS, RDS, and Aurora, LLM evaluation science for AI-powered agent experiences, or agent memory architectures that enable persistent, adaptive behavior across sessions. You will work closely with applied scientists, software engineers, and product teams to enhance existing models and build new ones that solve challenging customer problems. You will drive implementation of proposed models, establish testing strategies to validate them before and after production, and define evaluation metrics that determine whether capabilities meet the quality bar. We value accuracy over speed, measurability over intuition, and simplicity over complexity — the simplest model that meets the bar wins. You are an analytical problem solver who enjoys diving into data, are excited about investigating and developing algorithms, and can influence technical teams and business stakeholders to solve real-world customer problems.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of building models for business application experience
* PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
* Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience using Unix/Linux
* Experience in professional software development

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

* Work with a collaborative, high-performing team of engineers and operators

* Hybrid work setup with flexibility for hands-on collaboration
* Opportunity to innovate and expand drone software capabilities at a rapidly growing startup

new_jobs.title: Product Engineer - Onboarding Automation
new_jobs.description:
**About Stuut**
===============

Stuut is the AI coworker that runs order-to-cash for the world’s leading enterprises. Across order management, credit, collections, payments, cash application, disputes and deductions, Stuut does the work end to end and keeps going until the cash hits the bank.

Over 150 companies, spanning the mid-market to the Fortune 50, including Honeywell, ZoomInfo and PerkinElmer, use Stuut to unlock up to 40% more cash flow and cut DSO by 47%. More than $3 billion has moved through the platform to date.

Founded in New York by Tarek Alaruri and Ben Winter, Stuut has raised $93 million from Insight Partners, Andreessen Horowitz, M12, Microsoft’s Venture Fund, and others. Learn more at stuut.ai.

**The Role**
------------

We're hiring our first Product Engineer dedicated to customer onboarding. Your job is to make bringing a new customer live on Stuut faster and smoother, and to build the tools our Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) team uses on every implementation.

Every new customer brings its own ERP, data, email templates, and collections process. You'll work alongside our FDEs, find the steps that can be automated, and ship the tools that make each onboarding faster than the last: a smarter intake form and the APIs behind it, and agents that turn a customer's existing collateral into a configured account.

This work also lays the foundation for channel partners to implement Stuut for their own clients.

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

Within your first quarter, you've shipped an onboarding automation used on live customers. Within 12 months, customers go live meaningfully faster, your tooling is a core part of every implementation, and it's robust enough for channel partners to use.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Build the intake-to-configuration path:** Turn our intake form into a full product, with the APIs behind it so customer inputs configure an account end to end.
* **Ship agents for onboarding:** Build LLM-powered tools that turn customer collateral (email templates, collection playbooks, process docs) into working Stuut configuration.
* **Make customer data easy:** Make ERP data, flat-file, and schema mapping fast and reliable, whether that means building or integrating the right tool.
* **Improve the onboarding toolkit:** Continuously improve the tools and automation our FDEs use on every implementation.
* **Find the bottleneck, ship the simple fix:** Work with FDEs and customers, measure where time goes, and ship the smallest thing that moves it before building the big thing.
* **Build for partners:** Design onboarding tooling that channel partners can use too.
* **Build with agents:** Use coding agents daily to ship quickly, while owning the testing and debugging of what they produce.

**You Might Be a Fit If You…**
------------------------------

* **Ship real LLM features:** You've built agents, tool use, and prompt/eval loops that run in production, not just demos.
* **Build APIs and backends:** You're comfortable designing APIs that take structured input and configure a system end to end, in a large existing codebase.
* **Handle messy data:** You've worked with ERP data, flat files, schema mapping, validation, and cleaning. ETL experience is a plus.
* **Have product sense:** You can talk to internal users and customers, find the biggest bottleneck, and ship the simplest fix first.
* **Work autonomously:** You scope your own projects once given priorities, and you're comfortable being the first person in a function that may grow into a team.
* **Work agent-native:** You use coding agents every day and can explain and stand behind their output.

**Suggested background:** 5+ years as a software engineer, with time in backend, full-stack, or forward deployed roles at a B2B SaaS or fintech company. We weigh shipped work and judgment over any specific title.

**Bonus Points**
----------------

* You've worked as a forward deployed, implementation, or solutions engineer.
* You've built B2B SaaS onboarding, or worked in fintech, AR/AP, or ERP.
* You've built tools that partners or customers use to implement a product themselves.

**US Compensation**

* Top-of-market salary and equity package
* Benefits (for U.S.-based full-time employees)
* Medical, dental & vision insurance coverage for you
* 401(k) & Match
* Equity
* Flexible PTO
* Parental Leave

**Stuut is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a team with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.**

We are also committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the application and interview process. If you need any accommodations, please do not hesitate to reach out.

Compensation Range: $190K - $220K

**About Manifest**
==================

Manifest OS is the leading AI-native company on a mission to replace the billable hour and make legal services more accessible for American businesses and consumers. We power the next generation of AI-native law firms with one unified global brand, a proprietary technology platform, and a centralized back office — enabling lawyers to eliminate the administrative burden and focus on delivering exceptional outcomes for their clients. Manifest OS has raised a $60M Series A from Menlo Ventures, Kleiner Perkins, First Round, and Quiet Capital.

**About the Role**
------------------

Manifest is building its B2B attorney-facing product from the ground up, and we're looking for a technical, product-minded builder to own it. You'll build and evolve the Portal and Command Center, the core products attorneys use to manage cases, interact with AI-powered workflows, and deliver legal services.

This is a hands-on, 0 1 role for someone who can move between understanding user problems, designing technical solutions, and building and shipping AI-native product experiences. You'll work closely with Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Legal to turn complex workflows into intuitive products that attorneys actively use.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own the end-to-end development of the attorney-facing Portal and Command Center, from identifying problems to building and shipping solutions
* Design and build AI-native features that read, analyze, and generate case-related work using LLMs and agentic systems
* Work hands-on with AI coding tools and agents to prototype, test, and ship product functionality
* Translate complex legal and operational workflows into intuitive product experiences
* Work directly with attorneys and internal teams to understand user needs, gather feedback, and iterate quickly
* Partner closely with Engineering to define technical requirements, evaluate tradeoffs, and bring product ideas to life
* Build and improve integrations, data models, and underlying workflows that power the attorney experience
* Define product metrics, measure adoption and performance, and use data to guide product decisions

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* Experience building and shipping products in a 0 1 environment, ideally at a high-growth B2B company
* Strong technical foundation, with the ability to understand system architecture, data models, APIs, and integrations
* Hands-on experience building AI-native products using LLMs, AI agents, and modern AI development tools
* Comfortable using AI coding tools to prototype, build, and iterate on working product experiences
* Experience translating complex user problems into technical solutions and shipped products
* Strong product instincts and ability to balance user experience, technical complexity, and business impact
* Familiarity with LLM evaluation, testing, and reliability in production environments
* Ability to work across Engineering, Operations, Sales, and Legal in a fast-moving environment
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical work experience

**This Is for You If...**
-------------------------

You’re a hands-on builder who enjoys working at the intersection of product and engineering. The focus is on prototyping and shipping solutions rather than spending weeks writing specs. Success requires comfort with ambiguity, a strong connection to users, and the ability to take a product from initial concept through adoption and scale.

**This Is Not for You If...**
-----------------------------

You prefer a traditional product management approach, with a focus on defining requirements and handing execution off to Engineering. This role requires a willingness to get hands-on with AI tools, technical systems, and rapid prototyping, as well as an interest in shaping the roadmap rather than working from an established one.

Compensation Range: $200K - $250K

new_jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Evals
new_jobs.description:
**About David AI**
------------------

At David AI, our vision is to bring impactful AI into billions of lives through voice. Our mission is to help the world's leading AI companies build better voice models and agents. We're building the data and evaluation infrastructure behind those models.

Founded in 2024, we're a fast-growing Series B company backed by NVIDIA, Meritech, First Round, YC, and others, with ~70 people across San Francisco and New York City.

**About this role**
-------------------

We're building David AI's first **Forward Deployed Evals** team. Voice models can only improve on what someone can measure, and most of what matters in voice has never been measured well. This team finds those gaps with our customers and builds the evals to close them.

As a **Forward Deployed Engineer, Evals**, you'll be the primary partner to a set of customers' research teams. In a typical week, you might spot a regression in the latest model checkpoint and design a targeted eval for it, build it end-to-end, calibrate findings against human ratings, and follow through to ensure the model improves.

This is a builder role that is intentionally cross-functional, requiring you to be capable across GTM, Ops, Product, Research, and Engineering to deliver on outcomes.

**In this role, you will**
--------------------------

* Be the evaluation partner to research teams at the world's leading AI labs: learn what they're trying to fix in their voice models, and find what they haven't thought to measure yet.
* Dig into human and automated eval results, pin down exactly where and why a model fails, and decide which failures deserve a dedicated eval.
* Go from idea to working eval in days, independently building whatever the problem calls for: human data pipelines, detectors trained on human labels, or synthetic test harnesses.
* Make every number defensible: an eval you ship should track what people actually hear, and it should hold up when a senior researcher pushes on it.
* Tell research leads what to focus on in their next checkpoint and why, with the data to back it up.
* Productize what works, or turn it into a playbook the team can repeat.
* Shape how forward deployed evals work at David AI as one of the first people on the team.

**Your background looks like**
------------------------------

* 2-7+ years of experience as a technical builder across engineering, product, operations, and research (we're hiring at multiple levels); this might have been as a forward deployed engineer, applied data scientist, ML engineer, product manager, management consultant, or something else entirely.
* You're exceptional at building with AI agents, and you've personally built at least one ambitious thing you can walk us through in detail.
* You move fast. You solve problems in days that might take someone else a month, and you own ambiguous, high-stakes work end to end.
* Strong, demonstrated analytical chops: experiment design, statistics, and knowing whether a metric actually captures what you care about.
* Strong customer presence: you have the credibility and clear communication to earn the trust of technical customers and senior stakeholders.
* Excited to work in person in San Francisco or New York.

**Bonus points if you have**
----------------------------

* Been a founder, or founding engineer/PM/etc. at a startup.
* Experience with speech, audio, or voice models.
* Built or published a benchmark you can share with us.
* Experience working with human raters, annotation, or data-labeling workflows.
* Worked at an AI data or evals company.

**Benefits**
------------

* Unlimited PTO.
* Top-notch health, dental, and vision coverage with 100% coverage for most plans.
* FSA & HSA access.
* 401k access.
* Meals 2x daily through DoorDash + snacks and beverages available at the office.
* Unlimited company-sponsored Barry's classes.

**Visas**
---------

We sponsor international candidates across several visa types, including H-1B *transfers*, H-1B1, O-1, E-3, and TN. We also hire candidates on STEM OPT. If you’re on STEM OPT, we’ll want to confirm you have a path to one of the visas listed above before your OPT ends. While we can’t guarantee any individual outcome, we’ve successfully sponsored teammates from all over the world.

Compensation Range: $165K - $225K

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Do you want to help define the future of Go to Market (GTM) at AWS using generative AI (GenAI)?  
  
AWS Worldwide Specialists Org (WWSO) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.  
  
You will be part of the core worldwide GenAI Training and Inference team, responsible for defining, building, and deploying targeted strategies to accelerate customer adoption of our services and solutions across industry verticals.  
  
You will be working directly with the most important customers (across segments) in the GenAI model training and inference space helping them adopt and scale large-scale workloads (e.g., foundation models) on AWS, model performance evaluations, develop demos and proof-of-concepts, developing GTM plans, external/internal evangelism, and developing demos and proof-of-concepts.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
You will help develop the industry’s best cloud-based solutions to grow the GenAI business. Working closely with our engineering teams, you will help enable new capabilities for our customers to develop and deploy GenAI workloads on AWS. You will facilitate the enablement of AWS technical community, solution architects and, sales with specific customer centric value proposition and demos about end-to-end GenAI on AWS cloud.  
  
You will possess a technical and business background that enables you to drive an engagement and interact at the highest levels with startups, Enterprises, and AWS partners. You will have the technical depth and business experience to easily articulate the potential and challenges of GenAI models and applications to engineering teams and C-Level executives. This requires deep familiarity across the stack – compute infrastructure (Amazon EC2, Lustre), ML frameworks PyTorch, JAX, orchestration layers Kubernetes and Slurm, parallel computing (NCCL, MPI), MLOPs, as well as target use cases in the cloud.  
  
You will drive the development of the GTM plan for building and scaling GenAI on AWS, interact with customers directly to understand their business problems, and help them with defining and implementing scalable GenAI solutions to solve them (often via proof-of-concepts). You will also work closely with account teams, research scientists, and product teams to drive model implementations and new solutions.  
  
You should be passionate about helping companies/partners understand best practices for operating on AWS. An ideal candidate will be adept at interacting, communicating and partnering with other teams within AWS such as product teams, solutions architecture, sales, marketing, business development, and professional services, as well as representing your team to executive management. You will have a natural appetite to learn, optimize and build new technologies and techniques. You will also look for patterns and trends that can be broadly applied across an industry segment or a set of customers that can help accelerate innovation.  
  
This is an opportunity to be at the forefront of technological transformations, as a key technical leader. Additionally, you will work with the AWS ML and EC2 product teams to shape product vision and prioritize features for AI/ML Frameworks and applications. A keen sense of ownership, drive, and being scrappy is a must.  
  
A day in the life  
Drive end-to-end technical engagements with strategic customers, including foundational model builders, physical AI innovators, and enterprise architects, by deeply understanding their business context and designing tailored AWS-powered solutions. You will present compelling architectures to executive and technical stakeholders, then guide implementation teams through successful adoption. Beyond delivery, you will serve as a critical voice of the customer, collaborating directly with AWS service team leaders to surface product gaps and shape roadmap priorities, ensuring AWS continues evolving alongside the industry's most demanding and forward-thinking builders.  
  
About the team  
The Frameworks team specializes in computational workloads, performance evaluation, and optimization. We partner with foundation model builders, large-scale training customers, and physical AI innovators to solve complex challenges across the full ML stack. Our expertise spans hardware (GPUs, Custom Silicon), operating systems, communication libraries (NCCL, MPI), frameworks (PyTorch, NeMo, JAX), and models (Llama, Nemotron). We also support physical AI workloads involving real-time inference, robotics simulation, and sensor data pipelines. Additionally, we work with containers (Docker, Enroot), orchestrators (EKS), and schedulers (Slurm) to deliver scalable, high-performance solutions for the most demanding AI applications.

* 4+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

* Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
